episodes.title: The Man Who Stole the Fortune of the Gods
episodes.description:
This story was instant gossip as it happened back in 1930. Many versions since then have focused on the magic, cult and distractions.  

Our goal was to focus on the gold. The story behind the man, which is classical tale of rags to riches.  Most cults prey on the desperate and less fortunate.  Brother XII made his fortune by convincing the richest and smartest people to hand it all over.

  To make this documentary, I spent hours digging through old articles.  Days were spent trying to find primary sources to get past all the tabloid noise to the core of the story as it happened then.  Preserved in this video is original articles from 1927-1933. 

Sources: BC Archives. Vancouver Sun. Daily Colonist. Nelson News. Nanaimo Archives.
